The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of a machine learning technique and a 3-D posture estimation method can be a good choice to achieve a satisfactory performance in human activity recognition.

the use of the RGB-D camera is not the key to success in activity recognition; instead, the key is to use the information provided by the camera in a proper way, i.e., by focusing on the human posture.
the combination of a few machine learning techniques, namely, K-means clustering and HMMs, can be successfully used to recognize human activities from 3-D posture data.
